title: Physical Therapy & Rehab Quarter-over-Quarter Volume Shift
dataSources: MedBridge exercises (`medbridge:exercise`), PT clinic sessions (`pt:session`), Hinge Health sessions (`hingehealth:session`), rehab range-of-motion logs (`rehab:rom`), and pain diary entries (`pain:diary`).
app: MedBridge exercise completions, clinic PT session exports, Hinge Health digital sessions, ROM measurement logs, and pain diary entries forwarded to Splunk HEC.
spl:
index=personal sourcetype=pain:diary
| bin _time span=1q
| stats count as events by _time
| streamstats current=f last(events) as prev_q by _time
| eval qoq_pct=round(100*(events-prev_q)/prev_q,1)
| where isnotnull(prev_q) AND prev_q>0
| sort - _time
description: Compares event volume quarter over quarter for physical therapy telemetry in index=personal.
value: Seasonal life domains swing a lot; a quarter view separates real habit change from normal summer/winter noise without overreacting to one bad week.
implementation: Keep `pain:diary` events flowing into `index=personal` with stable timestamps, then review QoQ percent change during quarterly personal ops reviews.
visualization: Column chart of events by quarter with QoQ percent labels.
grandmaExplanation: It keeps how much your physical therapy activity changed compared with last quarter so you can tell a real shift from normal seasonal ups and downs.
